text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: metering.token_count_drift (severity: P2) — 65 customers with >10% token delta in last 30m
oncall-ryan: acked, jumping in. can someone grab initial blast radius? :eyes:
metering-emma: looking now — running quick rollup across emitters to find skewed shards
eng-ops-sam: seeing duplicated emits from emitter em-12 and em-13 in the last 20m, dup_ratio ~1.12 on a subset of partitions
infra-liz: noticed a recent deploy to emitter cluster 3 (2027-11-01T02:14Z) — rollback candidate if needed
metering-emma: sql to verify counts: ```SELECT customer_id, SUM(tokens) as tokens_last30m FROM usage_events WHERE ts >= now() - interval '30 minutes' GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY tokens_last30m DESC LIMIT 100;```
eng-ops-sam: logs show repeated ack for same message id on em-12: `2027-11-01T02:18:07Z em-12 WARN duplicate_msg id=msg_8f2a emitter=em-12 count=3`
billing-ana: we already have several customers receiving automated overage flags — pausing overage notifications for impacted customers now (temporary) :neutral_face:
support-jordan: support doc draft prepared, will send to affected customers after we have scope. holding until billing confirms pause list
oncall-ryan: prioritise: 1) stop noisy emitter, 2) pause customer-facing overage alerts, 3) gather reconciliation snapshot
metering-emma: can toggle emitter drain for em-12 and em-13 without full rollback. issuing drain command now: `curl -X POST https://infra.internal/emitters/em-12/drain -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"`
infra-liz: drain accepted for em-12, em-13; traffic rerouting in progress, expected stabilization ~2-4 mins
billing-ana: paused automated overage emails for affected cohort (IDs pulled from quick query) — marking in billing dashboard as "suppress_alerts: true" for 65 customers
eng-ops-sam: starting reconciliation job: batching exact event counts vs emitted tokens, running against last 2 hours snapshot. job id: recon-20271101-02
metering-emma: initial diff sample: customer C-847 had emitter-sum=1,240,000 tokens, ledger-sum=1,120,000 => +10.7%
support-jordan: prepping templated message: "We detected a reporting anomaly affecting usage for some customers. We're investigating and temporarily suppressing overage notifications. We'll follow up with corrected statements."
oncall-ryan: good. chat with legal if we need to proactively notify larger enterprise accounts. Ana — can you flag any accounts >$5k/mo?
billing-ana: flagged and added to "priority_notify" list (7 accounts). will coordinate with AE leads after recon
eng-ops-sam: recon job results streaming: looks like duplicates correlate with partition key modulo mismatch after deploy; duplicate messages were acked twice due to consumer group not de-duping at the write layer
metering-emma: mitigation plan: 1) keep em-12/em-13 drained, 2) switch to read-through dedupe path for writes (fast toggle), 3) run backfill reconciliation for the 2-hour window to correct counters
infra-liz: fast toggle route available via infra feature flag: `feature.billing_write_dedupe = on` — applying now to staging then prod path
eng-ops-sam: applying flag to prod canary on 2 nodes first then roll. ETA ~8 mins for canary results
billing-ana: once dedupe is on, we'll un-suppress alerts but queue corrected billing events to be emitted to invoicing pipeline after reconciliation completes
support-jordan: collecting list of customers that already got an overage flag so we can send a tailored follow-up with corrected numbers
oncall-ryan: decision: do NOT issue mass customer emails yet. limit to private outreach for top accounts. keep suppression in place until recon finishes and we can confirm corrections. I'll remain on call
metering-emma: dedupe flag is on canary nodes; early metrics show duplicate rate dropping from 1.12 -> 1.003 on canary traffic :tada:
eng-ops-sam: canary looks good. rolling flag to remaining nodes now
infra-liz: roll complete. drain still active on em-12/em-13. traffic normalized on other emitters
metering-emma: reconciliation completed for window 02:00-04:00 UTC. corrections identified, will emit compensating events to ledger writer with idempotency tokens. job results: 65 customers affected, total overcount ~2.4M tokens (aggregate)
billing-ana: queueing corrected billing entries to billing-processor with tag `incident/1820304050-recon` — setting apply_on_invoice=false to avoid surprise charges until we validate with accounting
support-jordan: drafted outreach for priority accounts; internal FAQ in #support pinned. ready to send after accounting sign-off
oncall-ryan: postmortem owners: emma (metering), sam (ops), ana (billing), liz (infra). please add timeline to incident board and set severity/impact
metering-emma: timeline notes added. root cause: deploy introduced partition mapping change that allowed duplicate ack sequences for a short window; mitigations: improved pre-deploy check for partition mappings, add dedupe at write layer, emitter drain/runbook update
billing-ana: recommending credit/correction playbook for customers impacted. will propose credits in next 24h after accounting verifies
support-jordan: will handle inbound tickets and has templates ready. assigned two support engineers for 4h rota
oncall-ryan: closing the active pager in 30m if no regressions. keeping channel open for any late regressions. great work everyone :thumbsup:
